_llm_flag.suggested_fix: phase identification: XRD shows Li6PS5Cl (x=0) is single-phase argyrodite (ICSD #259205); at low N doping (x=0.125, 0.25) argyrodite remains the major phase but slight Li2S and LiCl impurities are observed; for x ≥ 0.375, additional N-containing/impurity peaks appear and impurity peak intensity increases with x; at x=1 argyrodite peaks are hardly seen and impurities dominate. LPSNC-0.25 is refined as cubic argyrodite (space group F-43m).
